finalText:
**Big but mostly mechanical.** About 1,200 hits in 94 files, five services.

Four places it must not be renamed:

| Zone | Why |
|---|---|
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml) | public contract, frozen |
| [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8) | wire value stays `account_id` |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | regenerated, edits lost |
| `migrations/*.sql` | applied, editing is fake |

Also 125 SQL column refs in repos. Those need a real column migration first.

Safe today is the JS variable rename only. Sign off scoped to that.
